title: Land Preparation (Continued) and Planting
text:
2. Harrowing - helps to provide finer seed bed and destroy emerging weeds.

3. Furrowing - helps to provide irrigation to the plants

B. Planting
1. Seeds - most legumes can be reliably established from seed.

i. Proper caring of seeds:
a) Seeds may die quickly if not dried and stored properly and keep them dry.
b) For every percentage increase in seeds moisture above 10%, the forage life of seeds halved.
c) Conduct germination test to determine the quality of seeds.
d) For seeds with hard seed coats, use scarification techniques or soak the seeds in hot water for 20 seconds before planting.
e) Seeds should not be sown deeper than 1 cm or they cannot emerge.

2. Vegetative materials - easy and reliable in establishing grasses. Start with small nursery areas and plant out at the start of the wet season.

facts: Harrowing helps provide a finer seedbed and destroy emerging weeds.
Furrowing helps provide irrigation to the plants.
Most legumes can be reliably established from seed.
Seeds may die quickly if not dried and stored properly in dry conditions.
For every percentage increase in seed moisture above 10%, the storage life of seeds is halved.
A germination test should be conducted to determine seed quality.
For seeds with hard seed coats, scarification techniques or soaking in hot water for 20 seconds before planting should be used.
Seeds should not be sown deeper than 1 cm or they cannot emerge.
Vegetative materials are easy and reliable in establishing grasses.
When using vegetative materials, farmers should start with small nursery areas and plant out at the start of the wet season.
